create_named_aggregation: create a NamedAgg to specify column-specific aggregations with custom output column names in groupby operations
build_series_groupby_aggregate: build a SeriesGroupBy aggregation pipeline that supports string functions, lists of functions, and named aggregation via kwargs
build_dataframe_groupby_aggregate: build a DataFrameGroupBy aggregation that supports dict-based per-column function mapping and named aggregation
run_series_groupby_transform: run a SeriesGroupBy transform that applies a function group-wise and returns a same-indexed Series result
run_dataframe_groupby_transform: run a DataFrameGroupBy transform with fast and slow path selection that returns a same-indexed DataFrame result
test_series_groupby_nunique: test the SeriesGroupBy nunique method that counts distinct values per group using factorization and bincount
test_dataframe_groupby_nunique: test the DataFrameGroupBy nunique method that counts unique values per column per group
run_series_groupby_value_counts: run a SeriesGroupBy value_counts that returns counts of unique values per group with optional bins and normalization
run_dataframe_groupby_value_counts: run a DataFrameGroupBy value_counts that returns counts of unique rows per group with optional subset and normalization
run_series_groupby_filter: run a SeriesGroupBy filter that selects groups based on a boolean criterion function applied per group
run_dataframe_groupby_filter: run a DataFrameGroupBy filter that selects groups based on a scalar boolean criterion function applied per group
run_series_groupby_idxmax: run a SeriesGroupBy idxmax method that returns the row label of the maximum value in each group
run_series_groupby_corr: run a SeriesGroupBy corr method that computes pairwise correlation between each group and another Series
run_dataframe_groupby_corr: run a DataFrameGroupBy corr method that computes a pairwise correlation matrix for each group
